-- Same result. Let me also verify by looking at the individual qualifying gaps
WITH drive_order AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
),
consecutive_drives AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor, a.last_round as prev_last_round,
           b.constructor_id as next_constructor, b.first_round as next_first_round,
           b.first_round - a.last_round - 1 as missed_races
    FROM drive_order a
    JOIN drive_order b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, prev_constructor, prev_last_round, next_constructor, next_first_round, missed_races,
           prev_last_round + 1 as first_missed_round,
           next_first_round - 1 as last_missed_round
    FROM consecutive_drives
    WHERE missed_races > 0
),
qualifying_driver_years AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING SUM(missed_races) < 3
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT g.year, g.driver_id, g.first_missed_round, g.last_missed_round, g.prev_constructor, g.next_constructor
    FROM gaps g
    INNER JOIN qualifying_driver_years qdy ON g.year = qdy.year AND g.driver_id = qdy.driver_id
    WHERE g.prev_constructor != g.next_constructor
)
